title: Studio: add a new action to an installed app's object, saved in the customization package
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

The maintainer: 「studio没有操作类型的元数据吗？除了批量操作，别的也需要配置的呀。」 (2026-11-04). Measured by the seat on `main` `63b86b385d`, on the example CRM and a throwaway writable package. No `domain:*` label is set: triage routes this card.

## Business reason

An operations person wants a 标记合格 button on the leads of an installed CRM. Studio has a good action editor, but only for a writable package. On an installed app the object's 操作 tab lists the vendor's actions and offers no 新建, so the most common real case is the one case with no door. The platform already accepts the result.

## Measured

| Check | Result |
|:--|:--|
| Writable package, 对象 → 高级 → 操作 | 新建操作 with presets (修改下拉选择字段, 运行流程, 打开网页, 在对话框中打开页面, 高级), the full editor and placements 记录头部, 记录 · 更多菜单, 记录 · 分区, 记录 · 关联列表, 列表 · 行 |
| Read-only CRM, same tab | Lists the actions, with no 新建 or 删除, and the 只读 chip shows |
| `PUT /api/v1/meta/action/eval_1104_lead_qualify?package=com.example.crm.custom&mode=draft`, a new name with `objectName: 'crm_lead'`, then publish | 200, `published` |
| The running CRM | The row menu shows the new action, and it ran: `POST /api/v1/actions/crm_lead/…`. The move it tried was not allowed, and the state machine refused it with 线索不能变更到这个状态。 |
| The Studio tab after that publish | Lists it, with type SCRIPT and no 新增 mark |

The action in a writable package is stored on the object draft (`draft.actions`, `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` `CelPanelTab`), not as a separate item. On a read-only object that route cannot save, so the door has to write a standalone `action` item into the pair, as the API call above did.

## Acceptance

1. On a read-only base with a pair, the object's 操作 tab offers 新建. It uses the same presets and editor and saves a new-named action into the pair as a draft.
2. Vendor actions stay read-only in that list, and the added one carries the customization mark and can be edited and removed.
3. It publishes with 待发布的变更, and 仅看定制 counts it.
4. A browser check on the CRM: add, publish, see it in the row menu, run it, remove it.
5. No spec or server change is expected. If one is needed, report it here.

## Not in this card

Changing a vendor's action (#30065), and selection-bar placement (the decision card filed beside this one).

## Re-check

`git grep -n "viewMode === 'actions'" origin/main -- ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design`
